richiami.difetto: During anti-corrosion treatment the steering box mounting surfaces were not adequately masked. As a result anti-corrosion paint contaminated the mating surfaces leading to insufficient metal-to-metal contact when the steering box was installed. This can cause the steering box to loosen over time potentially affecting steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Removed anti corrosion paint from mating surfaces.
richiami.titolo: Steering Box Mating Surfaces Contaminated with Anti-Corrosion Paint

richiami.modello: BYD AD ENVIRO400 , BYD AD ENVIRO400
richiami.rimedio: Service Bulletin Reference 966 Rev 3 must be adhered to.  A permanent solution is being investigated.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles incorrect tempering of the anti-roll bar causes failure due to metal fatigue.
richiami.rimedio: Check and replace the front anti-roll bar.
richiami.titolo: On affected vehicles incorrect tempering of the anti-roll bar causes failure due to metal fatigue.

richiami.difetto: The HVAC DCAB protection box may become loose resulting in damage to wiring and overheating /electrical short.
richiami.rimedio: Check the fixings for presence and security. Replace the HVAC DCAB protection box if necessary.
richiami.titolo: The HVAC DCAB protection box may become loose resulting in damage to wiring and overheating /electrical short.

richiami.difetto: The driver can adjust the steering wheel position while the vehicle is in motion. The vehicle may become difficult to control if the driver was to adjust the steering position while driving.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit an Interlock device so adjustment can only be made while the handbrake is applied.
richiami.titolo: STEERING WHEEL MAY BE ADJUSTED WHILST DRIVING

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the material used to manufacturer the Pitman arm from is not to the correct specification. This can cause wear of the arm and lead to possible detachment of the drag link which could lead to loss of control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all vehicles for the replacement of the pitman arm with a new quality enhanced item.
